late arrival for time critical care visit
Acarer may cut short his / her visit to one client to enable them to arrive to their next scheduled appointment on time

In circumstances where a carer is cutting short a visit, the client in question does not receive the duration of care they have been assessed as requiring (or indeed which Comfort Call Ltd has been paid to provide)
